sources.content:
import math
import torch
from flash_attn import flash_attn_varlen_func


@torch.no_grad()
def run(q, k, v, qo_indptr, kv_indptr, sm_scale):
    qo_indptr_i32 = qo_indptr.to(torch.int32)
    kv_indptr_i32 = kv_indptr.to(torch.int32)

    q_lens = qo_indptr_i32[1:] - qo_indptr_i32[:-1]
    kv_lens = kv_indptr_i32[1:] - kv_indptr_i32[:-1]
    max_seqlen_q = int(q_lens.max().item()) if q_lens.numel() > 0 else 0
    max_seqlen_k = int(kv_lens.max().item()) if kv_lens.numel() > 0 else 0

    result = flash_attn_varlen_func(
        q, k, v,
        qo_indptr_i32, kv_indptr_i32,
        max_seqlen_q, max_seqlen_k,
        causal=True,
        softmax_scale=sm_scale,
        return_attn_probs=True,
    )
    output, softmax_lse, _ = result

    lse = softmax_lse.transpose(0, 1).contiguous() / math.log(2.0)
    return output, lse
